submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. One independent1254x1254 RGBA transparent animation frame. Image1 is exact15 water-dragon-scholar edit target, preserve its native canvas and character scale. Image2 is CURRENT09 archer same-direction movement-structure reference ONLY, not identity/clothing/weapon. Image3 identity and image4 approved paint/material finish. Keep15 blue/ivory/gold robe, navy bun and blue tassels, white trousers, bluegold boots, one fan held by anatomical RIGHT hand and LEFT hand empty. Preserve head, torso, camera, hair, face, sleeve and robe motion except named local repair. No whole-body shift/rescale/recenter, no mirrored frames or pasted cutouts. No ground, cast shadow, particles, text or effects. FRONT view running SOUTH, airborne phase. Correct ONLY anatomical RIGHT trailing leg at screenLEFT. Its boot currently points diagonally outward to screenLEFT; rotate the knee-calf-ankle-foot chain into the SOUTH forward/backward plane, so the shoe longitudinal heel-to-toe axis points straight toward screenBOTTOM/viewer, not diagonally left. Keep this trailing leg tucked behind under its own hip, knee naturally flexed, with original boot approximate air height(source bottomabout1060), no planting. Preserve other screenRIGHT forward leg and its elevated foot exactly; preserve all upper-body, right-hand fan, empty left hand, head position, size, hair and cloth. Use image2 trailing leg alignment only. Do not just squeeze leg spacing or twist the foot without reconnecting ankle.
